label: Unlinked readings from Thomas Aquinas, De ente et essentia
summary: cap.1 [69872]: ens per se dicitur dupliciter, uno modo quod dividitur per decem genera, alio modo quod significat propositionum veritatem: The contrast distinguishes categorical being from affirmative propositional truth even about privation. A case bridge would have to map the ten-category sense to esse in re rather than simply treat the two proposed divisions as the same.
